_doc: Surge energy. A hit earns its attacker damage x per_damage_dealt x per_type_mult[move type] x variety_energy[move types the combo has used, this hit included] (clean hits, blocked chip and armor chip alike; a Surge's own hits never charge the next one). So lights alone barely fill the meter and combos that mix move types fill it fastest. A missing type is 1.0; a missing table is 1.0 throughout. per_damage_taken: energy the defender gains per point taken (no type or variety factor). carry_between_rounds: in a best-of-three the meter you ended a round with is the one you start the next with (damage and stamina still reset). Read by MatchSim.energy_rules() / energy_dealt(); part of Netplay.data_hash. Tuned with tests/bench_cpu.gd --combat (docs/plans/combat-metrics.md).
